capabilities: Convert heading-based documents to Markdown tables and back
Convert selected text in place between document and table format
Transpose rows and columns in a note or table
Back up notes to a configurable location before converting
Report conversion errors in a dialog or an error note with line numbers
extras: Manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README documents edge cases such as rejected transposes on title conflicts and that selection conversions are not backed up, and mentions BRAT as an install option.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to switch hierarchical heading-based content into tabular form or the reverse, or to swap a table's rows and columns.
summary: Converter that transforms heading-based Markdown documents into Markdown tables and back, and transposes rows and columns.
